id: \bViola uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak against Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
en: \bViola uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak against Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
it: \bVioletta usa Pokémon di tipo Coleottero. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Volante e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark. Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark.  Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Psico, Erba e Buio. Anche Lotta, Erba e Terra non fanno molti danni.

id: \rViola: You look like an interesting Trainer. May I take your picture?
en: \rViola: You look like an interesting Trainer. May I take your picture?
it: \rVioletta: Sembri un Allenatore interessante. Posso farti una foto?

id: \rA picture of your defeat would go great for my collection. Will you be strong enough to deny me?
en: \rA picture of your defeat would go great for my collection. Will you be strong enough to deny me?
it: \rUna foto della tua sconfitta starebbe benissimo nella mia collezione. Sarai abbastanza forte da impedirmelo?

id: \rTM113 contains Megahorn. A powerful bug type attack.
en: \rTM113 contains Megahorn. A powerful bug type attack.
it: \rL'MT113 contiene Megacorno. Un potente attacco di tipo Coleottero.

id: \rViola: I'm always here to take a picture if you want.
en: \rViola: I'm always here to take a picture if you want.
it: \rVioletta: Sono sempre qui per farti una foto, se vuoi.
